children: A connected fitness experience that turns training, nutrition, and progress into understandable decisions.
0→1 product design | Mobile product | Design system-led
Fitness guidance loses trust when the system knows more than it explains.

Nexa brings daily training, nutrition, recovery, and progress into one product model. The experience had to reduce fragmentation while keeping every meaningful recommendation understandable and user-controlled.
Plan, perform, and adjust a session without losing context.
Use ranges, food provenance, and portions instead of false precision.
Read trends and individual measurements across light and dark contexts.
The workout stays usable while the system investigates.
The active-session card keeps set entry, rest, effort, and the next exercise in one hierarchy. When progress stalls, the investigation attaches to the exercise instead of interrupting the workout.

attrs.alt: Approved Nexa active-session and volume-gap states
Approved Nexa nutrition summary, search, and portion states

children: Useful guidance without pretending food is exact.

Calories remain a range. Macro targets, food provenance, recent history, search results, and portion selection work together so users can log quickly while still understanding what the estimate represents.
Patterns become legible without turning the product into a dashboard.
The progress hub provides an overview in Sandstone. Detail views can move into Charcoal when focus and contrast need to increase, while navigation and reusable metric structures remain consistent.

attrs.alt: Approved Nexa Sandstone progress hub and Charcoal body-weight detail

children: The system proposes. The user decides.
Nexa turns patterns across training, nutrition, and progress into explainable suggestions. The public case study shows the decision relationship without publishing the internal adaptive architecture.
A clear explanation of what changed
The interface was designed as a reusable system, then tested in real product contexts.
Shared color, type, spacing, controls, cards, state behavior, and responsive rules let Training, Nutrition, and Progress feel related without forcing every surface into one visual treatment.
The public story shows the product decisions. The deeper system remains available on request.
Request the complete walkthrough for component anatomy, state matrices, motion behavior, validation evidence, and the internal adaptive decision model.
